claims.statement: Tom Allen coached Ed Smith when Smith beat Joe Goddard at the Olympic Club in New Orleans, in a fight printed as March 32, 1893.
claims.excerpt: it was the latter who coached him when he beat Goddard at New Orleans

claims.statement: Ed Smith was a great friend of Tom Allen.
claims.excerpt: He was a greut friend of Tom Allen

claims.statement: Tom Allen said that Swift was an old friend of his, whom he heard from often until recently.
claims.excerpt: He was an old friend of mine and I used to hear from him often until recently.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Swift was one of the gamest fighters that ever entered the ring. But he was hardly big enough for the heavyweights of this*day.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: He was an old friend of mine and I used to hear from him often until recently.
quotes.topic: on Swift as an old friend

notes: Article is about Ed Smith's death; Allen appears as Smith's coach and friend and as a speaker. The Smith-Goddard fight is not an Allen fight. Quotes name Swift; unclear whether this is the same man.
